app_initialization_desc: Choose how you want the application to start. Playlist First: You will be prompted every time to choose the playlist before the app initializes. Automatic: The app will automatically choose your last selected playlist, or the first playlist by default.
change_language_desc: Select your preferred language for menus, navigation, and on-screen text.
channel_theme_desc: Choose the layout and the background backdrop used by the Live TV page.
clear_cache_desc: Free up storage and resolve playback issues by clearing temporary app data. This will reset all the settings, favorites, watching progress. The app will restart to apply these changes.
clear_watch_lists_desc: Remove all saved items from your Continue Watching categories.
custom_categories_desc: Create your own collections and add channels, movies and series to them.
custom_categories_disabled_desc: Turn on the switch above to create and manage your own collections.
custom_categories_empty: No custom categories yet. Create one to get started.
empty-notifications: There are no notifications to show.
epg_loading_title: Please wait while downloading and parsing Epg Data. It will take some time.
exit_app: DO YOU WISH TO EXIT APP?
font_size_desc: Customize the font size for the app interface text for better readability.
hide_categories_desc: Choose which content categories (Adult, Sports, etc.) you want to hide from the main interface.
home_theme_desc: Choose the Home background and how content is arranged on the Home screen.
live_initialization_desc: Control which live channel/category is selected by default on Live TV page startup.
load_on_demand_desc: When enabled, the app will only request data when you actually open a section (Movies, Series, or Live). This helps the app start faster by reducing the initial loading time. When disabled, all content data (Movies, Series, and Live) will be loaded together when the app starts, which may increase startup time but allow faster browsing later. This setting will take effect the next time you load the app
loading_message: Stream live TV, movies and series from your own provider. Customisable playlists, parental controls, and a player built for the big screen. This app ships with no content — you bring your own playlist.
logout_confirm_desc: This will unlink this device from Stararcs. You can register it again at any time by reopening this page.
media_player_type_desc: Choose how video is played. Native uses the device player. HLS uses HLS.js. Shaka uses Shaka Player. MPEGTS uses mpegts.js for raw TS streams and falls back to HLS automatically. Turn on Auto Switch Player to ignore the choice below and let the app pick the player from the stream being played.
